name: Cedar of Lebanon
desc: The reserve's signature conifer, forming forests on the slopes of Mount Barouk. Goat browsing on young trees hinders its natural regeneration.
about: Cedrus libani, commonly known as cedar of Lebanon, Lebanon cedar, or Lebanese cedar (Arabic: أرز لبناني, romanized: ʾarz lubnāniyy), is a species of large conifer in the pine family, Pinaceae, and is…
